types.name: google.protobuf.GeneratedCodeInfo.Annotation.Semantic
types.doc:
Represents the identified object's effect on the element in the original
 .proto file.

values.name: NONE
values.doc: There is no effect or the effect is indescribable.

values.name: SET
values.doc: The element is set or otherwise mutated.

values.name: ALIAS
values.doc: An alias to the element is returned.
